_about: THE BIG WORK WAITS FOR A NAME (JOBS 11/18, VAMILY rule 453, the jobs' systems the way Battle Brothers runs them). Battle Brothers: 'The higher your Renown, the higher the reward from Contracts and the more difficult Contracts people will entrust you' (bb_all/1679 Renown), and its fortified settlements give no regular contracts, only the Noble House's, which 'require completing an ambition to reach Professional Renown (1050) to unlock' (bb_all/0724). Ours had the first half (CLOUT raises the pay, engine/bohemia_renown.js payMult) and not the second: CLOUT opened no work. NOW the work below waits on a board until the company's CLOUT reaches its number (slices/bohemia_board_shelf.js __THE_BIG_WORK_WAITS_FOR_A_NAME__); a board is never empty (rule 335): a place whose every job waits posts its least dangerous one. The board says the number (one label, draft). Read by tier (a fortress is the wiki's fortified settlement; our fortresses are the factions' strongholds) and skulls. TUNING's to move.

needs.quote: Contracts found here are given out by the Noble House and require completing an ambition to reach Professional Renown (1050) to unlock.
needs.quote2: The higher your Renown, the higher the reward from Contracts and the more difficult Contracts people will entrust you
needs.why: the wiki's 1050 for a fortress's three-skull work (its noble work); ours on the wiki's second line: a fortress's two-skull work and any town's or camp's three-skull work wait for 250, the wiki's Recognized (our SEEN AROUND), about three jobs done. A fortress's one-skull work and every job a town's news brings ask no name.

fade.why: JOBS 11/20 (rule 461, the handoff's next job): Battle Brothers' Renown fades three a day, so a company that stops working is forgotten and the big work waits again. Ours: every day that passes takes 3 CLOUT (never under 0), counted on the map's own clock (slices/bohemia_job_kinds.js __A_NAME_FADES__, through BohemiaRenown.add). A job done is +100 here (renown.json), so a day's fade is a thirty-third of a job, against Battle Brothers' eighth (+25 a contract): the same direction, gentler; TUNING's to move.
